subject: M-layer kickoff — matrix exponentiation as a drop-in layer
body:
Team,

Kicking off the M-layer effort formally. The pitch: our open-source "Intelligent Matrix Exponentiation" work gives us a single Keras layer (MLayer) that can learn periodic and multiplicative structure that stacked ReLUs handle badly. The product angle is a robustness-friendly building block we can offer inside our modeling toolkit.

Milestones I want to hold for the window ending 2026-06-22:
1) By 04-10: MLayer API hardened, unit tests, import path stable.
2) By 05-15: reproduce the CIFAR10 robustness results from M_layer_Robustness.ipynb against our internal harness (Evalline).
3) By 06-12: periodicity extrapolation demo for the launch review pre-read.

Daniela owns staffing; Umar and Fumiko own the robustness study; Farah and Oyin own the API and Evalline integration. Flag risks early — I'd rather cut scope in April than in June.

Thanks,
Anders
